title: Prospective evaluation of the correlation between healing of osteosynthetically treated patella fractures, knee function and quality of life
summary:
With the help of this study we would like to follow up the functionality of the knee and the resulting quality of life after surgically treated patellar fracture.  All patients who will be operated on at our clinic in the coming years due to a patellar fracture will be asked whether they would like to participate in the study. 

With the help of a questionnaire, the function of the affected knee and the resulting quality of life will be determined at the time points shortly after the fracture (memory of before the accident), and then after 6 weeks, 3 months, 6 months and 1 year. 

We will then assess the postoperative X-rays taken at the respective time points for healing of the patella using a rating system.

interventions.name: Patients with osteosynthetically treated patella fracture by means of plate osteosynthesis
Patients with osteosynthetically treated patella fracture using tension-band osteosynthesis
Patients with osteosynthetically treated patella fracture by screw osteosynthesis
Patients with osteosynthesised patella fracture by means of other osteosynthesis

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Surgical treatment of a patella fracture, verbal and written consent to the study
Exclusion criteria:
Age <18 years, lack of presentation for follow-up appointments
